# Naimah Collections

> A modest-wear label in Leicester, England: open and closed crepe abayas, linen and crepe kaftans, chiffon and jersey wrap scarves, and underscarves. Every piece is listed with its fabric, its length in each size and its price, and is posted folded in tissue.

- [Abayas](https://naimahcollections.com/abayas.html): open abaya £68, closed abaya £74, five lengths, two widths
- [Kaftans](https://naimahcollections.com/kaftans.html): linen kaftan £58, crepe kaftan £62
- [Scarves and underscarves](https://naimahcollections.com/scarves-and-underscarves.html): chiffon £18, jersey £16, underscarves £10 for two
- [Order your piece](https://naimahcollections.com/order-your-piece.html): order request form with running total
- [The label](https://naimahcollections.com/the-label.html)
- [Delivery](https://naimahcollections.com/uk-and-international-delivery.html) · [Returns and exchanges](https://naimahcollections.com/returns-and-exchanges.html)
